title: Werkstudent*in Data & AI in Commercial Effectiveness
desc:
Sanofi erforscht, entwickelt und vermarktet therapeutische Lösungen – als lebenslanger Begleiter in Gesundheitsfragen.
Der Hauptsitz des Konzerns ist in Paris. Die deutsche Landesgesellschaft unterhält ihren größten Standort in Frankfurt am Main. Für unseren Standort im Herzen von BERLIN (Nähe Park Gleisdreieck) suchen wir ab dem nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt Unterstützung (15-20h/Woche) im Team Commercial Effectiveness.

Folgende Interessen und Kenntnisse bringst du mit
Datenanalyse & Tools

• Sehr gute Kenntnisse in MS Office (insb. Excel, PowerPoint, PowerQuery)
• Erste Erfahrung mit BI-Tools (z. B. Power BI, Tableau)
• Grundkenntnisse in SQL
• Erste Erfahrung mit Datenbanken (z. B. Snowflake) von Vorteil
• Interesse an pharmazeutischen Märkten und Vertriebsprozessen
Künstliche Intelligenz (AI)

• Interesse an Large Language Models (LLMs) im Business-Kontext
• Erfahrung mit Tools wie ChatGPT, Copilot oder Claude
• Grundkenntnisse in Prompt Engineering und AI Use Cases
Prozessautomatisierung

• Erste Erfahrung mit Microsoft Power Automate oder ähnlichen Tools von Vorteil
• Verständnis für die Automatisierung von Geschäftsprozessen

Dein Profil
Du bist immatrikuliert in einem Studium wie z. B.: BWL, Business Administration, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Gesundheitsökonomie oder ähnliches.
Du sprichst Deutsch auf C1/C2 Niveau und bringst gute Englischkenntnisse (B2 oder höher) mit.
Du denkst analytisch und gehst strukturiert an Aufgaben heran.
Du arbeitest eigenständig und eignest dir schnell neue Themen an.
Du arbeitest gerne im Team und kommunizierst klar und auf den Punkt.
Du arbeitest zuverlässig und mit einem hohen Qualitätsanspruch.
Du kannst komplexe Inhalte einfach und verständlich erklären.

Als Werkstudent im Bereich CFC Commercial Effectiveness unterstützt du unser Team dabei, Vertriebsstrategien zu optimieren, Kundensegmentierungen weiterzuentwickeln und datenbasierte Entscheidungen zu fördern. Du arbeitest direkt an praxisrelevanten Projekten – mit einem besonderen Fokus auf datengetriebene Analysen– und erhältst tiefe Einblicke in die kommerzielle Exzellenz eines globalen Pharmaunternehmens.
Deine Aufgaben

Datenanalyse & Reporting

• Analyse von Vertriebs- und Marktdaten sowie Datenextraktion mittels SQL
• Erstellung von Reports und Dashboards zur Steuerung der Commercial Effectiveness
• Identifikation von Trends und Ableitung konkreter Handlungsempfehlungen
AI & LLM-Anwendungen

• Evaluierung und Einsatz von LLM-basierten Tools (z. B. ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude) für Business Use Cases
• Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung von Prompt-Strategien und AI-Anwendungsfällen im Vertrieb
• Mitarbeit an Prototypen und Proof-of-Concepts für datengetriebene Lösungen
Prozessautomatisierung

• Unterstützung bei der Automatisierung von Geschäftsprozessen mit Microsoft Power Automate
• Identifikation von Automatisierungspotenzialen und Entwicklung von Workflows
Commercial & Sales Effectiveness

• Analyse und Optimierung von Vertriebsprozessen sowie KPI-Auswertungen
• Unterstützung bei Territory-Alignment-Projekten
• Erstellung von Präsentationen und Entscheidungsvorlagen

Wir bieten Dir
Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zum teilweisen mobilen Arbeiten.
Ein modernes, internationales Arbeitsumfeld.
Zugang zu Sanofi-Lernplattformen und internen Trainings.
Eine individuelle und strukturierte Einarbeitung in Deine Aufgaben sowie Mitarbeit an strategisch relevanten Projekten.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung. Bitte richten Sie diese ausschließlich elektronisch an unseren Partner Provadis Professionals GmbH unter Werkstudent*in Data & AI in Commercial Effectiveness

Pursue progress, discover extraordinary
Better is out there. Better medications, better outcomes, better science. But progress doesn’t happen without people – people from different backgrounds, in different locations, doing different roles, all united by one thing: a desire to make miracles happen. So, let’s be those people.

title: Quality Control Graduate
desc:
• Location: Waterford, Ireland
• Start Date: 1 September 2027
• Duration: 23 months | Two 8-month rotations, and 7-month
• Working Model: Fully on-site
• Working Hours: Full-time
• Salary: €41,600 gross per annum
• Assessment Centre: January 2027 | In person, Waterford

Your opportunity at Sanofi
Ready to turn your academic knowledge into real-world experience?
Join Sanofi, a global biopharmaceutical company, through our 23-month Graduate Programme in Waterford. Explore three different functions, gain hands-on industry experience and develop the skills to shape your future career.

As a Quality Graduate, you'll explore how quality is maintained, improved and managed across pharmaceutical operations. From quality control and continuous improvement to quality management systems, you'll gain practical experience, contribute to meaningful projects and build a strong foundation for a career in pharmaceutical quality.

One programme. Three rotations. A world of experience.

Why explore just one area when you could experience three?
Our structured Graduate Programme takes you through three rotations (two 8-month rotations, and 7-month), providing exposure to different functions, meaningful projects and opportunities to learn from experienced professionals.

Your rotation journey
Rotation 1: Quality Control Chemistry| Months 1–8
Start your journey in the Quality Control Chemistry, where you'll discover how quality control processes, laboratory operations and compliance activities support pharmaceutical quality standards.

• Support ongoing quality control compliance activities and learn about Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) requirements.
• Contribute to digital transformation projects within Quality Control.
• Develop an understanding of analytical methods, specifications and quality control processes.
• Gain exposure to the management of quality control laboratory equipment.

Rotation 2: Quality Control Support Group | Months 9–16
Explore stability, compliance and QC systems developing analytical and problem-solving skills while contributing to cross-functional initiatives.

• Contribute to stability and compliance programmes
• Support quality projects, working towards agreed timelines, budgets and deliverables.
• Develop data analysis skills and participate in cross-functional quality projects.
• Support the maintenance and continuous improvement of quality management systems.
• Assist with document control and change management processes.

Rotation 3: Quality Control Micro | Months 17–23
Complete your journey in the Quality Control Micro, where you'll discover how quality control processes, laboratory operations and compliance activities support pharmaceutical quality standards from the microbiology perspective.

• Support ongoing quality control compliance activities and learn about Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) requirements.
• Contribute to digital transformation projects within Quality Control.
• Develop an understanding of aseptic practices, microbial analytical methods, and manufacturing processes.

Your development focus
Throughout the programme, you'll build practical knowledge and transferable skills to support your future career in pharmaceutical quality management or technical analytical expertise.
You'll have opportunities to develop:

• Quality management: Understand the principles and processes that support pharmaceutical quality standards.
• Analytical expertise: Understand the principals of chemical and microbial process.
• Regulatory compliance: Develop an understanding of regulatory requirements and Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP).
• Continuous improvement: Explore techniques for analysing processes, identifying opportunities and supporting improvements.

Your growth, our commitment
Your development is at the heart of our programme. Here's what you can look forward to:

• Three diverse rotations: Explore different functions and build a broader understanding of the business.
• Dedicated cross-functional mentor: Receive guidance from an assigned mentor, with monthly check-ins throughout the programme.
• A buddy in every rotation: Get practical, day-to-day support as you settle into each new team.
• Hands-on training: Learn directly from experienced colleagues and develop skills through practical experience and training opportunities.

Who we're looking for
We're looking for curious, motivated graduates who are eager to learn, collaborate and explore new opportunities.

To be eligible, you'll need to:

• Have graduated within the past two years or be due to graduate before 1 September 2027.
• Hold a minimum 2.1 primary degree or a Master's degree in Science (Chemistry, Biochemistry, or a related science discipline).
• Have full, unrestricted right to work in Ireland.
Essential skills:

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an interest in quality processes and continuous improvement.
• Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to work independently and take initiative.
• Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
• A proactive, self-motivated approach, with a track record of high performance and a determination to succeed.
• A passion for healthcare and a commitment to values aligned with Sanofi's.
Previous experience through internships, placements or relevant work is an advantage, but not essential.

Meet your teams
Quality Control (QC) is responsible for sample receipt, testing intermediate production samples, final product samples, and environmental samples to demonstrate that all products meet the standard requirements for CGMP operations. Additional functions include raw material testing, stability testing, assay transfers, and qualification of instrumentation.
The Quality Control Operations group supports Laboratory Investigations, Deviation Investigations, CAPA support, Training, and Change Controls. Quality Control Validation Support consists of the Method Validation…

title: Intern: Graduate( Non-Tech)
desc:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.
A Day in the Life

Chez Medtronic, vous pouvez entamer une longue carrière d’exploration et d’innovation tout en aidant à soutenir l’accès aux soins de santé et l’équité pour tous. Vous dirigerez avec détermination en surmontant les obstacles à l’innovation dans un monde davantage connecté et compatissant.

Contexte

Au sein du département des Affaires Réglementaires, composé de six collaborateurs et un collaborateur aux Pays-Bas, ce qui lui confère une dimension internationale.
Le département intervient sur les dispositifs médicaux, dans le respect des exigences réglementaires applicables, notamment du cadre réglementaire européen.

Mission générale du stage : Participer aux activités d’Affaires Réglementaires et de matériovigilance, tout en contribuant à l’amélioration des processus internes. Le/la stagiaire évoluera dans un contexte international.

Vos missions

1. Matériovigilance

• Participer à la gestion des déclarations d’incidents.

• Contribuer au suivi des échanges avec les clients, les distributeurs et les autorités compétentes.

• Effectuer la mise à jour des contacts de matériovigilance et le classement des documents associés.

• Assurer le suivi des activités du service.

2. Support aux Affaires Réglementaires

• Contribuer à la collecte et à la gestion des documents nécessaires aux appels d’offres.

3. Automatisation et optimisation des processus

• Participer au développement ou à l’amélioration d’outils automatisés (Excel, Power Automate ou autres).
• Contribuer à l’optimisation de la gestion de la boîte mail des Affaires Réglementaires (tri automatique, catégorisation et suivi).
• Proposer et mettre en œuvre des améliorations continues visant à fluidifier les workflows.

Votre profil

Vous êtes étudiant(e) en formation supérieure (cycle ingénieur ou master) dans l’un des domaines suivants : qualité, sciences de la vie, ingénierie biomédicale, pharmacie ou domaine équivalent.

Vous souhaitez développer vos compétences dans un environnement international et découvrir les enjeux des Affaires Réglementaires et de la matériovigilance dans le secteur des dispositifs médicaux.

Vous disposez des compétences suivantes :

• Intérêt pour le secteur des dispositifs médicaux : vous êtes curieux(se) de découvrir les exigences réglementaires qui encadrent ce secteur.

• Maîtrise d’Excel : vous êtes à l’aise avec les outils bureautiques et manifestez un intérêt particulier pour l’automatisation et l’optimisation des processus.

• Anglais professionnel (niveau B1+ minimum) : vous êtes capable de comprendre des échanges professionnels, de participer à des discussions et de prendre part à des réunions en anglais, à l’écrit comme à l’oral.

Vos qualités personnelles

Au-delà de vos compétences techniques, nous recherchons une personne :

• Curieuse et motivée, avec une réelle envie d’apprendre et de découvrir de nouveaux domaines.

• Proactive et force de proposition, capable d’identifier des pistes d’amélioration et de prendre des initiatives.

• Dotée d’un bon esprit d’équipe et d’excellentes capacités de communication.

• À l’aise à l’écrit, avec de bonnes capacités rédactionnelles.

• Rigoureuse et organisée, capable de gérer plusieurs missions simultanément avec méthode et efficacité.

Durée et lieu :

• Stage de 6 à 7 mois, à partir de février/mars 2027.

• Poste basé à Paris (75).

Pourquoi Medtronic ?

Rejoignez un leader mondial des technologies médicales, où votre travail contribuera à l’excellence opérationnelle et à l’innovation. Bénéficiez d’une expérience pratique dans un environnement dynamique et bienveillant, et ayez un impact réel dès le premier jour.

Prêt(e) à nous aider à façonner l’avenir de la production ? Postulez dès aujourd’hui !

Physical Job Requirements

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.

‌
‌

Recruitment Fraud Alert
We are aware of phishing scams targeting job seekers. Please keep the following in mind:

Apply only through official Medtronic channels. All legitimate Medtronic recruiting communications come from approved Medtronic platforms and official @medtronic.com email addresses.

Medtronic will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information (such as bank account or Social Security details) during early stages of the hiring process. Any such requests are not legitimate.

If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Medtronic, do not respond, click links, or open attachments.

If you have any questions, concerns regarding the authenticity of a communication alleged to have been made by or on behalf of Medtronic, please contact us immediately at AskHR@medtronic.com.

Benefits & Compensation
Medtronic offers a competitive Salary and flexible Benefits Package
A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values. We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help to create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every career and life stage.

Rémunération : 75% à 100% du SMIC, selon profil + avantages (ticket restaurant, accès au restaurant d'entreprise, prise en charge à 100% du Pass Navigo, un jour de congé payé par mois).

title: Stage - Ingénieur Développement Mécanique (H/F)
desc:
Chez Withings, nous souhaitons redonner aux individus le contrôle de leur santé.
Nous avons l’obsession de créer des produits beaux et intuitifs, afin que chacun puisse les utiliser facilement au quotidien; nos balances connectées, montres hybrides, tensiomètres, moniteurs de sommeil et tous les dispositifs de notre gamme sont aujourd’hui utilisés par des millions d’utilisateurs. Notre objectif : permettre la prévention, le dépistage et l’accompagnement d’un certain nombre de maladies chroniques via des produits et des services innovants, afin de révolutionner la manière dont on prend soin de notre santé.

Tes missions:
Intégré.e au sein de l'équipe Développement Mécanique , tu auras les responsabilités suivantes:

• Réaliser la veille technologique des matériaux utilisés dans l’acquisition de signaux sur nos produits et les procédés de fabrication associés
• Dessiner, prototyper et valider vos solutions techniques aux problèmes proposés (vous aurez un atelier bien équipé à disposition)
• Collaborer avec les équipes Sciences Appliquées et Électronique pour embarquer vos solutions techniques validées sur de futurs produits
• Participer à la conception de pièces de nos différents produits
• Participer à l’industrialisation de nos produits et à l’amélioration continue de nos lignes de production, en lien avec nos sous-traitants
Requirements

• En formation Bac+5 type grande école d’ingénieur ou équivalent
• Forte appétence pour le prototypage de pièces et le design d’objets connectés
• Vous maîtrisez au moins un logiciel de CAO (SolidWorks, Creo, CATIA, Onshape)
• Connaissances solides en matériaux, procédés de fabrications (plastiques, métaux, céramiques, verres, résines)
Benefits
Rejoindre l’aventure Withings, c’est :

• Intégrer un des pionniers et leaders mondiaux de la santé connectée, plusieurs fois primé au Consumer Electronic Show
• Contribuer à des projets innovants et ambitieux pour la santé de demain dans un environnement agile et en constante évolution
• Intégrer une entreprise internationale, membre de la FrenchTech 120, dont les équipes sont basées à Issy-les-Moulineaux, Boston, Hong-Kong et Shenzhen
• Participer à l’amélioration continue de nos produits et services en les bêta-testant avant leur sortie, notamment lors de nos nombreuses sessions sportives entre collègues
• Participer à des conférences de professionnels de santé afin de renforcer ses connaissances dans le domaine médical
• Collaborer avec des collègues passionnés et célébrer ensemble chacune de nos réussites !

• Toutes les candidatures reçues sont étudiées indépendamment de l’origine ethnique, des croyances, de la religion, du genre, de l’orientation sexuelle ou de la santé des candidats. Withings aspire à offrir et garantir l’égalité des chances aux candidats et seules les personnes habilitées (RH et Management) auront accès aux informations concernant votre candidature.

title: (Junior) CS Complaints Agent - German Speaking  (m/f/d)
desc:
Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing. Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.

Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.

Team

We are looking for a dedicated and competent professional to strengthen our team in the area of Solution Management EU, Customer Service. In this role, you will take on complaint handling, primarily for our German-speaking markets. Do you have a knack for de-escalation, work in a structured manner, and keep an overview even in challenging situations? If you want to drive complex cases forward in a solution-oriented manner and enjoy a constructive error culture, we look forward to receiving your application!

Your Responsibilities

• Complaint Management: You will handle customer complaints independently and on time. In doing so, you act in a solution-oriented and professional manner to ensure customer satisfaction even in difficult cases and a high-frequency environment.

• Root Cause Analysis & Optimization: You systematically analyze the reasons for complaints in order to identify operational weaknesses and initiate sustainable process improvements.

• Solution Orientation: You make well-founded decisions regarding goodwill arrangements within defined guidelines to achieve a fast and satisfactory solution for our customers.

• Quality Communication: You craft clear, empathetic, and comprehensive responses to complaints and ensure that every response is also regulatory compliant.

• Risk Assessment: You identify potential operational or legal risks at an early stage and support their minimization.

• Interface Management: You coordinate closely with internal departments (e.g., Product, Operations) to resolve complex issues quickly and in a customer-friendly manner.

Your Profile

• Completed training, ideally in banking or insurance, the legal field, or comparable areas.

• At least 1-2 years of experience in complaint management, customer service, or handling demanding customer inquiries – ideally in the financial services industry or a comparable regulatory environment.

• Strong understanding of de-escalation strategies as well as the ability to communicate complex issues in an understandable and solution-oriented manner.

• A strong ability to prioritize correctly even with high ticket volumes and to comply with Service Level Agreements (SLAs).

• A high sense of responsibility, teamwork skills, and a proactive approach to problem-solving.

• Minimum C1 fluency (written and spoken) in at least one of German or Dutch is required, along with good working proficiency in English (C1). Any additional language skills are a strong plus.

• Good IT skills (especially Google Workspace, Zendesk).

Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us!

At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities.

As part of our team, you will benefit from:

• Employee Development Budget of €2,000 and four full training days per year.

• Flexible working hours, home office and 30 vacation days.

• A company pension scheme (Betriebliche Altersvorsorge), which we support with 20%.

• Enjoy more than 50+ different sports with Urban Sports Club: We subsidize your membership with more than €20 per month.

• Do you miss being in the office? The Deutschland Ticket gets you there, which we subsidize with €25 per month.

• Love cycling? With JobRad, lease the bike of your choice and enjoy tax savings, plus Raisin covers your monthly insurance costs.

• Hungry all the time? Snacks, daily fresh fruit as well as drinks provided at the office.

• You are moving from another country or city to join us? We may support your relocation.

Raisin Applicant Privacy Policy

We value diversity and the unique experiences each individual brings. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for everyone, regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.

title: Talent Acquisition Intern (6 months)
desc:
[OUR MISSION AND CUSTOMERS] We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.7 on Trustpilot, https://www.trustpilot.com/review/qonto.com based on 60,000 reviews. Our culture https://qonto.com/en/careers/culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do (more about our culture here https://medium.com/qonto-way/the-qonto-way-our-culture-is-our-strategy-90defd4895f9).

 

[OUR JOURNEY] Founded in 2016 and launched in 2017 by Alexandre https://www.linkedin.com/in/aprot/ and Steve https://www.linkedin.com/in/steveanavi/, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

 

[OUR BELIEFS] We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, and 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process https://medium.com/qonto-way/a-recruiters-dilemma-confronting-bias-in-hiring-b78acce148eb because the best teams are built on merit.

 

[AI AT QONTO] AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here https://medium.com/qonto-way/ai-at-qonto-vision-statement-725a7e2f659b) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

 

Join us as a Talent Acquisition Intern to help us hire the interns and apprentices shaping Qonto's next generation of talent. You'll screen and source across Tech, Product and Business, working closely with our 25+ Talent Acquisition Managers, under the guidance of Aurélien https://www.linkedin.com/in/aurelien-drieu-203446123/, our Head of Talent Acquisition.



➡️ What you'll do

 - Hire our interns and apprentices: Alongside the other TA intern, you'll own CV screening and sourcing for every intern and apprentice role, across all teams.

 - Support senior hiring: You'll analyse the labour market to find candidates for critical, senior roles when needed.

 - Sharpen our process: You'll spot friction points in our hiring process and help fix them.

 - Drive TA projects: You'll contribute to initiatives like campus management, salary and perks benchmarking, and tooling improvements.
   
   

➡️ What we're looking for

 - Still studying, close to the finish line: You're pursuing a French Master's (or equivalent) in HR Management or a related field, and looking for your end-of-study internship.

 - Fluent in French and English: German, Spanish or Italian is a plus.

 - Hands-on and organised: You can juggle multiple priorities and keep a hiring process moving at pace.

 - A natural communicator: You'll represent Qonto to candidates, so you're comfortable presenting yourself and building rapport fast.

 - Open to working with AI: You're comfortable using AI tools to speed up screening, sourcing and admin work.
   
   

➡️ What we can offer you

 - A truly international team: Recruiters across France, Germany, Italy, Spain, Portugal, Austria and Belgium 🇫🇷🇩🇪🇮🇹🇪🇸🇵🇹🇦🇹🇧🇪.

 - Real ownership from day one: You and the other TA intern will run intern & apprentice hiring end-to-end, not just support it.

 - Exposure beyond your scope: You'll get pulled into senior hiring and strategic TA projects most interns never touch.

 - A front-row seat on scaling TA: You'll see up close how a 20+ person team hires at Qonto's pace.
   

➡️ Your future manager

You'll report to Aurélien https://www.linkedin.com/in/aurelien-drieu-203446123/, our Head of Talent Acquisition since July 2023, leading a team of 20+ recruiters hiring talent worldwide. Before Qonto, he spent years in executive search across France and Europe. He's hands-on and genuinely invested in making recruitment sharper and more effective for everyone involved.



Perks

 - Flex your schedule. Work from home up to 2 days a week with our hybrid policy.
   
   Stay active. Gympass gives you access to 3,000+ sports and wellness partners.
   
   Eat well. Lunch card, 50% on us.
   
   Get around. 50% of the cost of your public transportation pass is covered.
   
   Enjoy the rest. Team events, snacks, and beverages.
   
   Take time off. 1 paid day off per month, no questions asked.
   
   Be yourself. An inclusive, supportive environment where everyone belongs.


[DIVERSITY] At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick - who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.



[HIRING PROCESS DURATION] On average, our hiring process lasts 20 working days. More information on our candidate journey here https://qonto.com/en/careers/candidate-journey



[DATA RETENTION] By applying, you agree that Qonto processes your personal data to assess your application. Your data is kept for up to 2 years in our candidate pool. Read our Privacy Notice https://qonto.com/en/legal-documents/privacy-notice for full details.
